data.title: Ashes in Glass
data.style: Cinematic ambient outro with techno-noir sci-fi thriller tension, slow 72 BPM feel in minor key; verse-like opening stays on sparse dark drone and decaying piano over distant sub-bass, then a mid-section widens with colder harmonic layers and settling dust textures, final stretch thins to near-silence and soft resonance. Breathless room-tone, long tail delays, reversed swells, faint metallic creaks, intimate and desolate mix with wide cinematic depth., ambient, techno, slow, drone
